title: Phase 0 Inception — final desktop and mobile

q1.text: Open M1 (major, method decision): unanchored synonyms such as 'uas' are kept off the search string, which can hurt recall. Keep dropping them, keep them with a warning, or let the researcher force them in?

q2.text: Open M2 (major, design decision): directions are frequent phrases on a thin, query-shaped pool of 25 papers. Is a phrase count enough evidence to offer a direction at all?

q3.text: Open M3 (major, needs multi-field validation): the gates (12-paper floor, 0.50 top-3 share) were calibrated on one trial. The boards show them as fixed numbers until validated.

q4.text: Open M4 (major, Contract v1 gate): semantic results drift; provider, search date and mode are shown in the draft but are not in protocol.json. Adding them is a contract change.

q5.text: Open M5 (major, roadmap): no multi-database choice, PRESS review of the search, criteria pilot, dual screening or registration step in Inception.

q6.text: Open M6 (moderate, contract decision): four keyword-detected paradigms only; no PICO / SPIDER / PEO question framework (D5 says so on screen).

q7.text: Open M7 (moderate, design decision): three machine-ranked directions can steer the researcher. D4 orders by anchor count and offers 'Write my own direction'; is that enough?

decided.text: Decided in this pass: web app on localhost, CLI only as a 'Run from the terminal' disclosure. Nothing is written before Review and emit, the one write gate (D7). Every criterion shown verbatim with its source (you typed it / suggested from the pool / paradigm default) and accepted one by one; unaccepted items are drafts and block Continue (INC-22). Re-inception refuses to overwrite unless 'Replace and keep a backup' (INC-08, D9). Pool shows its age and Refresh; empty or failed searches are never cached (INC-09). Anchored means the term occurs in titles or abstracts, with the count (INC-21). Phase-4 trust settings labelled 'advisory · Phase 4 is parked' (PROT-01). SCREENING_CRITERIA preview renders date range and languages (PROT-08); dry run shows cross-field checks (PROT-02). One session id rec_7f3a… for desktop, phone, terminal and agent (UX#10). The agent path is a secondary entry. Phone reviews and accepts; the write gate stays on desktop; offline changes queue and conflicts go to you.

parked.text: Not production: Full text, Synthesis, Matrix, Graph and Trust phases (struck through in the stepper). Phase-4 verification settings are recorded as advisory only. Matrix columns are saved in the protocol but the Matrix phase that fills them is parked.
